patch.summary: Is Gamma worth it? Gamma is an AI presentation and document platform that generates slide decks, docs, and webpages from prompts. Free covers basic creation with limits. Plus is list price on annual billing (list price monthly) for premium AI models, branding removal, and expand…. Strong when Founders and marketers who need fast AI-generated pitch decks. Weak when Not a full LLM assistant — presentation/doc generation is the core job.

sections.heading: Who Gamma is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Gamma when AI-generated presentations and documents are the primary job — not when you need voice production or full websites..

Avoid if: Compare Wegic for website building, AdCreative.ai for ad creative, and ChatGPT if you need general LLM chat instead of deck generation..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Wegic on the same job-to-be-done.
